AKA Beverly Hills Hotel Residences
Extended Stay Suites in the Golden Triangle
Experience a luxury retreat at AKA Beverly Hills, offering discerning travelers a home away from home in one of California's most glamorous neighborhoods. Live like the A-list in our luxury serviced residences, in a private pied-a-terre perfect for weekly and monthly extended stays in Los Angeles. Whether you're traveling for leisure, business, medical treatments, home renovation, relocating or anything in between - you'll enjoy an inspired stay.

Situated in the heart of the “Golden Triangle,” our refined hotel residence is just steps from the world-famous shops of Rodeo Drive, the Los Angeles Museum of Art, Cedars-Sinai Medical Center, and illustrious gourmet dining such as Il Pastaio, Spago, and Funke. Discover personalized service, thoughtful amenities, and a host of unexpected touches that will ensure your stay is a memorable one.

Our collection of spectacular suites - including fully-furnished one and two-bedroom suites, penthouses, and townhomes, have been designed with the most discerning traveler in mind. Relax and unwind in thoughtfully curated spaces, featuring bespoke furnishings, gourmet kitchens, and fireplaces and private balconies in select suites. Outside your private retreat, stop by the elegant lobby and relax in the café and lounge area, visit our Technogym fitness center, or treat yourself to a luxury experience in our private cinema. There’s also a business center with a boardroom-style meeting space if you’re in town for business.

Discover everyone's Los Angeles fantasy when you stay at AKA Beverly Hills.
Let AKA Beverly Hills be your own Los Angeles pied-a-terre.

AMENITIES
From private film screenings in a.cinema to exclusive direct access to the legendary Spago restaurant, AKA Beverly Hills’ resident amenities are designed to enhance your lifestyle during your LA stay.

SERVICES
From valet parking and complimentary Wi-Fi, to making restaurant recommendations and more, the thoughtful resident services team at AKA Beverly Hills anticipates your every need.

DESIGN
Designed in collaboration with acclaimed firms Koning Eizenberg, Asfour Guzy Architects, and Pamela Burton and Company, spaces here encourage both comfort and creativity, offering an engaging and upscale atmosphere perfect for relaxing, hosting, or staying productive.

Relocation FAQ (official)
What is AKA Beverly Hills relocation housing in Los Angeles?
AKA Beverly Hills offers sophisticated, fully furnished residences in Los Angeles designed for weekly or monthly stays—ideal for corporate relocations, insurance stays, home renovations, and other transitions. Suites feature thoughtfully designed living spaces, fully equipped kitchens, and access to elevated amenities that make long stays effortless.
What’s the minimum stay at AKA Beverly Hills? Can I stay monthly? Yes—AKA Beverly Hills accommodates stays of a week or longer, with flexible monthly options for relocations, extended projects, or lifestyle transitions.
What in-suite features are included at AKA Beverly Hills?
Suites are designed to feel like home, featuring one- and two-bedroom layouts, penthouses and townhomes, separate living areas, fully equipped gourmet kitchens with crockery and cutlery, in-suite washer and dryer, ample storage, and thoughtfully designed residential comforts.
What amenities can I expect during a long stay?
Residents enjoy the Technogym® fitness center, a private cinema, residents-only terrace, and valet service, along with reliable Wi-Fi to support work and daily living. Weekly housekeeping and fresh grocery delivery help make life effortless.
Is AKA Beverly Hills pet-friendly? Yes — AKA Beverly Hills warmly welcomes pets. Please notify Resident Services in advance; pet fees may apply. Don’t miss the AKA Canine Club, our exclusive membership for four-legged guests.
Does AKA Beverly Hills offer corporate relocation rates or assistance? Yes. Book direct on StayAKA.com for the best value or contact our Los Angeles sales team at lasales@stayaka.com for corporate or long-stay arrangements.
Does AKA Beverly Hills offer extended-stay promotions? Yes — explore seasonal offers and extended-stay savings on our dedicated offers page.
Is relocation or insurance housing supported at AKA Beverly Hills? Absolutely — we regularly host guests relocating for work, undergoing renovations, or on insurance claims, with flexible terms and an elevated home-away-from-home experience.
Are utilities included? Yes — enjoy a hassle-free, all-inclusive living experience.

If you’re planning an extended stay in Los Angeles, these residences provide a superior option to monthly apartment rentals.

Frequently Asked Questions
What are the benefits of booking direct with AKA Beverly Hills?
Guests who book directly on StayAKA.com enjoy the best available rate, flexible cancellation policies, and exclusive amenities designed with your comfort in mind. Booking direct also ensures a seamless reservation experience with immediate confirmation, and personalized service. It’s the most reliable way to secure the best value and the full range of AKA benefits for your stay.
What time is check-in at AKA Beverly Hills? Is early check-in possible?
Check-in at AKA Beverly Hills is at 4 p.m. Early check-in is possible based on availability
What time is checkout at AKA Beverly Hills? Is late checkout possible?
Checkout at AKA Beverly Hills is at 11 a.m. Late checkout until 1 p.m. is based on availability for a half day fee (half of your nightly rate +tax). Any late checkout after 1 p.m. is a full night charge of room and tax.
Is there an age minimum for check-in?
The minimum age for check-in at AKA Beverly Hills is 18.
What is AKA Beverly Hills's cancellation policy?
Once a lease is signed, resident can modify or cancel up until 30 days prior to arrival date, based on the reservation.
Are pets welcome at AKA Beverly Hills? Is there a fee? What facilities and services are available for pets?
Pets are welcome at AKA Beverly Hills although we do have a breed restriction. The fee is $25 per night per pet for weekly stays, and $500 per pet for monthly stays.
Is smoking allowed at AKA Beverly Hills?
Smoking is not allowed in the building or outside of the building. Beverly Hills is a smoke free city
What makes AKA Beverly Hills the top luxury extended-stay hotel in Los Angeles?
AKA Beverly Hills is designed for stays of a week, a month, or longer, offering the space and privacy of a personal residence with the service of a boutique hotel. Each one or two bedroom suite features a separate living area, chef-inspired kitchen with high-end appliances, laundry, and all the essentials to work or entertain comfortably. Residents also enjoy access to amenities including a private cinema, fully equipped Technogym fitness center, and tranquil outdoor spaces bringing the comforts of home to your extended stay.
Does AKA Beverly Hills offer parking?
On-property parking is available, both self park and valet park for $40 per car, per night.
Is public transportation accessible from AKA Beverly Hills?
There is no public transportation but the metro is currently being built and is set to be completed by 2025
Is AKA Beverly Hills ADA accessible? What accessible features are offered at AKA Beverly Hills?
AKA Beverly Hills does not offer ADA suites
Are children welcome at AKA Beverly Hills? What facilities and services are available for children?
Children are always welcome at AKA Beverly Hills. We offer complimentary pack&plays - no cribs available
Does AKA Beverly Hills have bidets in the guest rooms?
We offer bidet installations at an additional fee of $100 per bidet.
Can I receive mail and packages at AKA Beverly Hills?
We gladly accept mail and packages on your behalf but ask that you register all guests staying in your suite with the front desk so we can properly identify packages/mail
Are rollaway beds available at AKA Beverly Hills?
Yes, rollaway beds are available 1-29 nights for an additional fee of $30 per night. For stays of 30+ nights, rollaway beds are available for an additional fee of $10 per night
Are blackout shades available at AKA Beverly Hills?
Yes, we offer blackout shades at an additional fee of $150 for a one-bedroom and $250 for a two-bedroom (to be hung in the bedrooms only).

Frequently Asked Questions
What makes AKA West Hollywood a leading luxury extended-stay hotel in Los Angeles?
AKA West Hollywood is designed for stays of a week, a month, or longer, offering the space and privacy of a personal residence with the service of a boutique hotel. Each suite features a separate living area, chef-inspired kitchen with high-end appliances, and all the essentials to work or entertain comfortably Residents also enjoy access to lifestyle amenities such as a state-of-the-art Technogym fitness center, private cinema, expansive pool and residents’ lounge bringing the comforts of home to your extended stay.
Does AKA West Hollywood offer parking?
On-property, covered parking is available for $30 per car, per day. There is the option to self-park or use our 24 hour valet service. Car info must be shared and a garage addendum must be signed upon check in to receive parking access.
Is AKA West Hollywood ADA accessible? We have ADA compliant suites available to book online.
Are children welcome at AKA West Hollywood? Children are always welcome at AKA West Hollywood. We offer large two bedroom suite accommodations that are perfect for families. Pack n' plays are available complimentary and additional roll away beds are $30 per night or $300 per month. Cribs can be rented from an outside company.
Can I receive mail and packages at AKA West Hollywood? We gladly accept mail and small packages on your behalf, up to 7 days before arrival. You will not have an individual mailbox.
What time is check-in at AKA West Hollywood? Check-in at AKA West Hollywood is at 3 p.m. Early check-in is possible based on availability.
What time is checkout at AKA West Hollywood? Checkout at AKA West Hollywood is at 11 a.m. Late checkout is possible, but not guaranteed, and may incur a fee.
Is there an age minimum for check-in? The minimum age for check-in at AKA West Hollywood is 18.
What is AKA West Hollywood's cancellation policy? There is no charge for cancellations made at least 7 days prior to your reservation date for weekly stays and 15 days prior for monthly stays. A fee of 50% of stay applies for cancellations or no shows made after the cancellation window.
Are pets welcome at AKA West Hollywood? Pets are always welcome at AKA West Hollywood. The fee is $15 per pet per day. We have a private pet path on site for resident to walk their dogs. A separate pet agreement must be signed upon arrival. Residents are responsible for any pet damages.
Is smoking allowed at AKA West Hollywood? Any type of smoking is not allowed in the building, or on the premises including balconies, common areas, and pool deck. Smoking fees start at $500 per occurrence.
What do I need to provide at time of check in? Is there a deposit? At time of check in, the credit card is swiped for a $500 refundable deposit.
What are the benefits of extending my stay? Extensions can be any number of nights. Consecutive stays of 30 nights and longer are tax exempt, meaning your extension past 30+ nights will result in a credit of taxes applied to your balance. Taxes in West Hollywood are 15.5%. You will also become eligible for the Monthly rate.
